text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A wild encounter, let's gooo! Wait, aren't we taking Trainer along too at this rate?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh, seriously~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Jordan and Trainer together, don't you think that's like total destiny?
choice_data_list: I have no idea at all...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold up!
For now, let's just 'here we go' it~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without understanding even half of what they were saying,
I was sandwiched between the two of them and hauled away...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Next up, "nail on Turf"—here I go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy! The usual Jordan style is here!
Come on, Trainer, get hyped too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer!
Half-assed. Are you totally hopeless at hyping people up or what?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, crank up the volume, will ya?
Blast it louder to get totally hyped up--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios cranked up the music,
filling the room with a blasting beat that shook the floor!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold back a bit!
I mean, bump up the volume on your own turn!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Here, Trainer-san, maracas for you!
Ah, or do you want the mic?
Ah, just take both~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I feel like I've stepped into some crazy place...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Phew, sang my heart out ♪
Gonna go grab a soft drink refill...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...What, are you pooped already?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Cheer up already~!
Come on, sing something~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, we'll just listen from right here~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've been dragged around quite a bit up to this point...
but this might be my chance to turn things around.
choice_data_list: Play a deeply touching song instead.
I'll get those gals all hyped up...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Never heard this song before.
Helios, do you know it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, isn't this what they call an oldie?
Guess I'll bang the tambourine for now.
Jordan, you wanna take the maracas?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Nah, I'll listen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Oho~ You're surprisingly good.
Never heard of that song before, though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this what they call it?
'Chilling'?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. Not bad at all.
What was that song just now? Tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Tosen Jordan had gained
just a bit of newfound respect for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A song that they know too,
and that's sure to get the crowd hyped—!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey, this is that thing!
A video, a video!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, for real, for real!?
Are we actually going for this!?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Fufu~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha!
Wait, you're doing the whole choreography too?!
For real?! You're going all in?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyy☆
Jordan's Trainer is seriously hilarious~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With their cheers and call-outs backing me,
I sang and danced with everything I had...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*phew*... That was hilarious.
I swear I've got a six-pack now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, it's not even a 6-pack anymore—
aren't those abs split into like 60 packs?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's way too over-the-top, that's just creepy... Ah, but no, I can't. I can't laugh anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to giving it everything I had,
they seemed to be satisfied.
